interpretation: Candidates 1-2 compare FFI i64 BigInt against Number; preparation fails.
Candidates 3-6 diagnose optional --config space syntax misparsed as a dependency; fixed --config=path uses only bare registration. No dependency installation succeeds or package bin runs.
Candidate 7 executes all checks on API 35 but its independent validator wrongly expects exit 159 instead of null plus signalCode.

Candidate 8 passes five environments, but its KILL_PROCESS control times out on API 28 kernel 4.4. Linux old thread-only semantics are consistent with the observation; this is a harness portability failure, not evidence of broken lchmod fallback.

Candidate 9 uses KILL_THREAD on every kernel and independently observes leader Z/31 before bounded owned group cleanup. The same seven cases and 1500 ms deadline are retained; all six environments are rerun.

interpretation.callerErrorBoundary: The bin linker ignores lchmod errors. EIO control intentionally exits zero but leaves mode 0600. This is a negative control, not propagated-error acceptance.
interpretation.syscallBoundary: Only this fixed internal bare-link path is newly validated. Raw openat2 is still unavailable before its filters; clone3, epoll_pwait2 and other syscall/thread/FD boundaries remain separate.
